description: As a remote sensing technician responsible for operational satellite monitoring, establish a fully automated, reproducible processing pipeline for the Landsat multispectral imagery located at /home/ga/snap_data/landsat_multispectral.tif. The pipeline must execute without manual GUI interaction — it should read the input data, apply a spatial subset to reduce the scene to a smaller region, compute a vegetation-related spectral index from the available bands, and produce an output product saved to /home/ga/snap_projects/. The processing workflow definition must be saved as a reusable file so that another operator could execute the same pipeline independently.
